entries.title: 2 Kings 15:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: To reign - Solely and fully to exercise his regal power.

entries.title: 2 Kings 15:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Six months - After the throne had been vacant several years, thro' the dissentions that were in the kingdom.

entries.title: 2 Kings 15:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Full moon - That dominion seldom lasts long, which is founded in blood and falsehood.

entries.title: 2 Kings 15:30
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Twentieth year - The meaning is, that he began his reign in the twentieth year after the beginning of Jotham's reign; or, which is the same thing, in the fourth year of Ahaz, son of Jotham.

entries.title: 2 Kings 15:33
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: To reign - Alone: for he had reigned before this, as his father's deputy.

entries.title: 2 Kings 15:35
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Gate - Not of the temple, but of one of the courts of the temple, probably that which led to the king's palace.
